data.gender_notes: Kamya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kamya is derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'desire' or 'longing'. In Hindu mythology, Kamya is a name given to various goddesses, including Kamya Devi, the goddess of desire and passion. The name Kamya carries the meaning “Desire, Longing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kamya usually hope their child will grow to embody desire, longing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kamya total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
